parameters.experiment: Q3 historical PV bias-correction diagnostic (C0_Linear vs C1_Bias28)
parameters.specification: reports/问题三/问题三_历史偏差校正轻量诊断实验方案.md
parameters.budget: new model training 0, MILP 0, dispatch re-runs 0

groups.C0_Linear: frozen Linear interval-mean PV and frozen W28/q80
groups.C1_Bias28: Linear + 28-day same-(publication hour, target) mean PV bias, non-negative truncation, own W28/q80 rebuilt from the historically issued corrected forecasts

parameters.bias: $u_{j,v,h}=V_{j,h}-\hat V^{(0)}_{j,v,h}$ (positive = the original forecast was too low); $b_{k,v,h}$ = arithmetic mean over the legal 28-day window, 0 when m<7; no trimming, no decay, no shrinkage, no full-year constant
parameters.correction: $\hat V^{(1)}=\max(0,\hat V^{(0)}+b)$; applied to the converted 10-minute interval-mean power; hourly nodes, interpolator and anchors unchanged
parameters.causality: b is always estimated from ORIGINAL Linear errors and never recursively from corrected errors; every historical corrected forecast uses its own b_j

protection.key: publication hour, target day-offset, target clock
protection.rule: ascending order statistic at position ceil(0.8m); zero when m<7

parameters.evaluation: publication days 2025-02-01..2025-12-31; 0:00 h=1..144, 6/12/18 h=36/72/108..144; the 0:00 auxiliary h=0 is generated but excluded from the main metrics

dependency.truth_source: results/q3_forecast_interpolation_diagnostic/forecast_archive.npz (attachment-2 truth under the accepted interval-start mapping)
